3	import numpy as np

6	def softmax(x):
7	    e = np.exp(x - np.max(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
8	    return e / np.sum(e, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
9	
10	
11	def layernorm(x):
12	    centered = x - np.mean(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
13	    variance = np.mean(centered * centered, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
14	    return centered / np.sqrt(variance + np.float32(1e-5))
